Coologics

Fractional growth lead · trial recruitment · 2026

11×
Trial enrollment

Finding participants through better creative

Coologics had a clinical study running months behind enrollment. Without participants the study does not complete, and without a completed study there is no FDA submission. The company’s path forward depended on filling it.

There was no recruitment function to inherit. I built it: the offer, the screening flow, the landing experience, the creative, and the media that fed it, under advertising rules that prohibit most of what a healthcare marketer would normally say.

Enrollment increased 11× and recruitment closed six months ahead of schedule, avoiding more than $500,000 in projected study costs.

11×

6 mo
Ahead of schedule
  • Built the recruitment funnel from zero: landing experience, pre-screener and the hand-off into the study team.
  • Wrote and tested creative at volume across UGC, practitioner testimonial, and feed and Reels formats, inside a narrow compliance envelope.
  • Iterated messaging on performance, not opinion. The winning angle was the one that named the condition plainly.
  • Ran the media and the budget against cost per qualified participant rather than cost per lead.

Multi-location retail · cannabis

Curaleaf

SEO and content consultant · 2019–2022

542k
Monthly organic, from 200k

Making a national retail website work locally

Curaleaf is the largest cannabis retailer in the US. Paid advertising is banned in the category, so organic was not a channel among several, it was the acquisition strategy. Every state has different products, different legal language and a different menu, which means fifty versions of the same page all competing with each other in search.

I built the architecture that kept them separate, and the content program that captured demand at the point where someone is deciding what to buy and where to buy it.

Monthly organic sessions grew from approximately 200,000 to 542,000, and organic became the primary driver of store and menu traffic.

2.7×
Organic traffic

  • Designed the site architecture and page templates behind 50+ state properties and every dispensary location page, so they ranked locally without cannibalizing each other.
  • Built the taxonomy across products, effects and conditions, which is what let a national site answer a local, regulated question correctly.
  • Ran the education program against what customers actually search before a first purchase, in a market where the brand cannot buy that attention.
  • Owned the publishing plan and the organic reporting across every market.

What I do

01

Outbound

Define the target market and ICP, build and enrich lists in Clay and Apollo, identify useful buying signals, and write email and LinkedIn sequences. I also handle domain setup, campaign build and reply workflows.

02

Paid acquisition

Launch and manage Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and Amazon campaigns. Write and test creative at volume, improve landing pages, and allocate budget on blended acquisition cost rather than platform-reported return.

03

Content and distribution

Write original research, benchmark studies, articles, and founder content. Adapt existing material for different channels and connect it to a clear next step for the buyer.

04

Search

Build content and technical SEO programs, develop free-tool acquisition strategies, and earn relevant links and mentions. Track how buyers find the company through both search engines and AI assistants.

05

Measurement

Set up tracking and reporting in HubSpot, GA4, and related tools. Make it possible to follow a prospect from first touch through conversion and understand what each channel contributes.

06

Email and conversion

Build follow-up sequences, onboarding emails, and HubSpot workflows. Test pages and forms to improve the conversion of traffic already coming in.
